data.name: OptAsOf
data.value: Lint against the rules in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the transaction date, else today.

data.name: OptBrand
data.value: Card brand to lint against: auto, visa, mastercard, amex, discover or all. Default: auto (reads card.brand).

data.name: OptCanonicalOnly
data.value: Print only the canonical JSON, one transaction per line.

data.name: OptCardProduct
data.value: Card product, overriding the payload: consumer, business, corporate, purchasing, fleet or commercialPrepaid.

data.name: OptConfig
data.value: Config file. Default: the nearest .l3lint.yaml walking up from the current folder.

data.name: OptCurrency
data.value: ISO 4217 currency for payloads that carry none, such as Braintree requests. Payload values win.

data.name: OptDirectory
data.value: Folder to write the files in. Default: the current folder.

data.name: OptDisable
data.value: Rule IDs or globs to skip, for example VISA-DQ-*. Repeatable.

data.name: OptDryRun
data.value: Print the patch without writing anything. This is the default.

data.name: OptExplainOutput
data.value: Output: text or json.

data.name: OptFailOn
data.value: Lowest severity that sets exit code 1: error, warning, information or none. Default: error.

data.name: OptFixAmount
data.value: Also recompute the transaction amount. Off by default because it changes what the card is charged.

data.name: OptForce
data.value: Overwrite files that already exist.

data.name: OptFormat
data.value: Input format: auto, canonical, stripe, adyen, braintree, cybersource, authorizenet, checkoutcom or csv. Default: auto.

data.name: OptLogFormat
data.value: Log format: text or json. Logs go to standard error.

data.name: OptLogLevel
data.value: Log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace. Default: warn.

data.name: OptLogValues
data.value: Include masked payload values in logs. Off by default.

data.value: Column map for CSV input.

data.name: OptQuiet
